theme_and_identity.vibe: Grounded, calming, authoritative yet empathetic. Replaces anxiety of medical results with clarity and reassurance.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Inject these Google fonts via Next.js or HTML head. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, large numbers, plain-language summaries

body_font.usage: Body text, tables, UI elements, labels, buttons

home_page.history_section: lg:col-span-4 flex flex-col gap-6 border-l border-[#E5E2D9] lg:pl-12

results_page.header_layout: flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-end mb-12 border-b border-[#E5E2D9] pb-8
results_page.table_container: bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 border border-[#E5E2D9] shadow-sm mb-12

uploader_dropzone.style: relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-16 border-2 border-dashed border-[#5C715E]/30 rounded-[2rem] bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm cursor-pointer transition-all duration-300

cards.style: bg-white rounded-2xl md:rounded-3xl p-6 md:p-8 border border-[#E5E2D9] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(28,33,31,0.03)]

buttons.primary: bg-[#1C211F] text-[#F7F5F0] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#1C211F] border border-[#1C211F] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium hover:bg-[#EEF2ED]
buttons.subtle: bg-[#EEF2ED] text-[#4A5A4B] rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-[#DCE3DB]

lab_table.header: border-b-2 border-[#1C211F] pb-4 font-serif text-lg text-[#1C211F]

status_badge.style: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider

motion_and_interactions.analyzing_state: Use Framer Motion to create a gentle pulse effect on the document icon and a loading progress bar that grows smoothly. Do NOT use frantic spinning loaders.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward translation (y: 20 to 0) using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Cards should have a subtle y-axis lift (-translate-y-1) and increased shadow depth on hover.

visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Apply a very subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to the body background (opacity 2-3%) to give a paper-like, tactile feel.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). They feel more premium and slightly rounded compared to standard icons.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used sparingly. Only on sticky navigation or floating action bars: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/40.

hero_background.url: None required. Use the off-white background with a subtle noise texture to keep the focus on the content and maintain a calm atmosphere.

consultation_placeholder.description: Doctor talking to patient in an office
consultation_placeholder.category: Useful for any 'Talk to a human' or 'Share with doctor' CTA cards

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use default Tailwind blue or generic neutral grays. Stick strictly to the warm earthy palette defined above.
Inject fonts via Google Fonts in index.css or layout: 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope'.
Ensure the dropzone takes up significant vertical space (e.g., min-h-[300px]) to feel substantial and inviting.
The lab results table MUST be easily scannable. Use the defined clinical_status colors for the badges to make normal vs abnormal instantly recognizable without causing alarm.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for testing.
Do NOT center align body text. Only center align the main hero uploader block and overarching H1.
Include a clear, visually distinct Medical Disclaimer section with high-tracking uppercase text to ensure legal/medical safety compliance.
For the 'Universal Key' requirement, implement the logic in the frontend calling the backend API seamlessly without asking the user for an API key.
